ui.extra.cacheClean:
1. Open Customer Support -> Self-Service Query -> Supply History inside Honkai Impact 3rd
2. If "User authentication expired" appears, close the game client
3. Click "Open cache folder" above and delete the Cache_Data folder
4. Relaunch the game and reopen Self-Service Query -> Supply History
5. You can also use "Proxy mode" under Option in the top right
ui.extra.findCacheFolder: If "Open cache folder" does not respond, manually open "Your install folder/Games/BH3_Data/webCaches/Cache/"
